d: Tanks are a symbol of the strength and force of mighty armies. Hardly any other invention has so decisively influenced world history in the 20th century as the tank. More than 100 years after the first tank battle in history, the documentary pursues the steel behemoth, traveling back in time on a multifaceted journey into history in two episodes.
